data.name: Mahipal
data.gender_notes: Mahipal is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahipal is a Sanskrit name for the Hindu deity Mahadev, who is the god of war and destruction. The name Mahipal is derived from the words 'maha' meaning great and 'pal' meaning protector or guardian. It is believed that Mahipal protects his followers from their enemies and helps them overcome obstacles in life. The name Mahipal carries the meaning “God of War” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Mahipal usually hope their child will grow to embody god of war and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mahipal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of War.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahipal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

By using the name Mahipal, one invokes the blessings and protection of this powerful deity.
